name: gsuquet-skills
description: Agent skills: install all of them with the "all" plugin, or one plugin per skill.

plugins.name: all
plugins.description: Every skill of this repository. Do not combine with the single-skill plugins.

plugins.name: interview
plugins.description: Interview the user in rounds of numbered questions, each with a recommended answer, until every decision of a plan, design or idea is settled, then end with a decision summary and wait for confirmation. Use only when the user asks to be grilled or interviewed, or to stress-test or challenge a plan, design or decision. Do not start it on your own for a task that merely needs planning.

plugins.name: write-for-agents
plugins.description: Write or review any text an agent reads, so that every run takes the same path through it. Use when writing or editing a skill, an AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, or a doc an agent reaches through a link.

plugins.name: write-skill
plugins.description: Write or change an agent skill in the agent-skills repository so that it works in Claude Code, Antigravity and other agents that read SKILL.md. Use when the user asks to add, edit, split or review a skill there.
